query: I'm designing "KEP-5681: Conditional Authorization" in kubernetes/enhancements and I'm considering using "Only one ConditionSet exposed as part of SubjectAccessReview status". Was that approach already considered on this project, and if so, why wasn't it adopted?
response:
Yes, this approach was considered in **`keps/sig-auth/5681-conditional-authorization/README.md`** under the section *"Only one ConditionSet exposed as part of SubjectAccessReview status"*.

It was not adopted because:
* If only one condition set is exposed, it might be impossible for a user to understand what conditions they are subject to for a given request when querying a `(Self/Local/Standard) SubjectAccessReview`.
* The first conditional response encountered might simply be a “deny dangerous operations”-type response rather than the full context.
* Consequently, the design instead aims to let the user see all conditional allows and denies until an unconditional response is reached.
